newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Whirlpool near-term.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Whirlpool near-term.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its rating of Whirlpool Corp to near-term neutral from reduce.
-- Merrill Lynch kept Whirlpool's long-term rating at neutral.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Merrill analyst Jonathon Goldfarb said in a report that a "credibility" issue has developed at Whirlpool.
-- Merrrill said Whirlpool's earnings "have been a huge disappointment the last two years." Profit margins and returns remain below average and operating cash flow is negative.
-- Whirlpool's stock price has fallen from $61 in late April to a 44-5/8 in early morning trading Thursday. Merrill said it "can envision its price dropping moderately further" in the future.
-- Merrill does not expect to become more positive about Whirlpool until there is clear evidence of an earnings turnaround.
-- Merrill said investors who now hold Whirlpool shares should continue to hold for an eventual rebound.
-- Merrill sees Whirlpool earning about $3.10 to $3.20 for the full year 1997.
